expected_issues.description:
`LANGUAGES` parsing should trim whitespace and drop empty entries (e.g. `"tr, en,"`). Otherwise you may request an empty/invalid language code.

```suggestion
const LANGUAGES = (process.env.LANGUAGES || 'tr,en')
  .split(',')
  .map(s => s.trim())
  .filter(Boolean);
```
